text: DSH SSH Control Center 是面向 Web 客户端的 DSH 插件，通过 Cordis bundle 注册统一的 ssh_control 工具，并在设置页提供 SSH 主机配置与插件卡片。工具可对单台或多台主机执行命令、读写和传输文件、查看日志与 Docker 状态、检查主机状态及管理 SSH 隧道，也可绑定会话默认主机。适合需要从 DSH 管理远程开发机、服务器或 NAS 的用户。使用时需本机具备 OpenSSH 命令和可用的 SSH 主机配置；具体远程目标由用户提供。

DSH SSH Control Center is a Web client plugin that registers the ssh_control tool and adds SSH settings. It runs commands on one or more hosts, transfers files, inspects logs and host status, and manages SSH tunnels. Users need local OpenSSH commands and must provide their SSH targets.

DSH SSH Control Center: use ssh_control upload or download to transfer files between the local machine and an SSH host.
DSH SSH Control Center 会通过本机 OpenSSH 将命令及用户请求读写或传输的文件内容发送到所选 SSH 主机；远程目标由调用者提供，代码未限定为固定服务端点。

A unified, non-intrusive SSH control center plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`@dsh-external/dsh-ssh-control`).

@dsh-external/dsh-ssh-control README · DSH SSH Control Center：This plugin equips DSH with **cross-platform (Linux & Windows), encoding self-healing (UTF-8 & GBK), stateless, and multi-host concurrent dispatch** capabilities. AI agents can seamlessly interact with remote Linux, NAS, Windows, and container hosts in the same session without hijacking or breaking the native local development environment.

---

@dsh-external/dsh-ssh-control README · 🌟 Key Features：- **Unified Composite Hub (`ssh_control`)**: Consolidates remote command execution, file IO, file transfer (`upload`/`download`), container inspection (`docker`), dynamic logs (`tail`), and port tunnels into a single tool, reducing Tool Schema token overhead by 85%+.
- **Cross-Platform Dual-Dialect (Linux POSIX + Windows PowerShell)**: Automatically senses remote OS types. Uses standard POSIX syntax for Linux hosts and PowerShell commands/paths for Windows hosts.
- **Intelligent Encoding Self-Healing (UTF-8 + GBK/CP936)**: Native multi-encoding detection and auto-transcoding for Windows Chinese systems, eliminating broken characters and garbled output.
- **Bi-Directional File Transfer (SCP Stream)**: Supports single file and directory upload (`upload`) and download (`download`), with multi-host batch dispatch.
- **Batch Multi-Host Concurrent Dispatch**: Natively supports comma-separated targets (e.g. `server: "nas-server, app-node, web-cluster"`). Powered by `Promise.all` concurrent SSH pipes for parallel batch execution and aggregated reporting.
